models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.description: Qwen3.8-27B is a 27 billion parameter language model from Qwen that mixes linear and full attention layers and supports up to 262,144 tokens of context. This card lists an FP8 build for one DGX Spark or one DGX Station and an NVIDIA NVFP4 build for one DGX Spark, served by SGLang with a short context of up to 9,216 tokens.

models.name: Qwen3.5-4B

This recipe serves the BF16 build on one DGX Spark, with up to 32,768 tokens of context and 4 concurrent requests, or on one DGX Station, with up to 8,192 tokens and 1 request at a time.

models.name: Nemotron Nano 12B v2
models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 12B v2 is a 12.3 billion parameter hybrid language model built mostly from Mamba-2 and MLP layers with only six attention layers, and it supports up to 131,072 tokens of context. This recipe serves the BF16 build on one DGX Spark, with up to 16,384 tokens of context, or on one DGX Station, with up to 8,192 tokens.

automaticHelmValidation.reason: Packaged Helm deployment passed readiness, registration, discovery, ordinary chat, streaming and authentication. Explicit /no_think plus enable_thinking=false passed an 8160-token prompt with up to 32 output tokens. Stop/resume and uninstall/reinstall reused the original verified cache, restored discovery and inference, and preserved the original model availability.

resolvedFailures.fix: Disable overlap scheduling for the no_buffer cache strategy.
Use the toggle-aware qwen3 reasoning parser. Non-thinking calls pair the checkpoint /no_think marker with enable_thinking=false.
Use the native non-mmap loader, reading one shard at a time. Hardware and host/device memory checks remain enabled.

resolvedFailures.failure: Repeated HTTP 502 from UDP GSO packet loss across the pod overlay. Direct backend HTTP succeeded.
resolvedFailures.fix: Shared router and Pylon use STARGATE_QUIC_DISABLE_GSO=true through their Helm values. Verified over a cross-node tunnel.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30 billion parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 3 billion parameters per token. It combines Mamba-2, mixture-of-experts and attention layers and supports up to 1 million tokens of context. This recipe serves the NVFP4 build on one DGX Spark, with up to 16,384 tokens of context, or on one DGX Station, with up to 8,192 tokens, with reasoning and tool-call parsing enabled.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a large mixture-of-experts language model with 512 routed experts, 10 of them active per token, a mix of linear and full attention layers, and a 262,144-token context window. This card lists an NVFP4 build from RadixArk, served by SGLang on one DGX Spark with local NVMe storage, on two DGX Sparks joined by a 200 Gbps link, or on one DGX Station.
models.license: Qwen Community 1.0 (base model); derivative card declares other

automaticHelmValidation.reason: Helm install passed placement, GPU qualification, cache integrity, readiness, registration, gateway discovery, chat, streaming and authentication at context 8192 and concurrency 1. The profile releases the checkpoint file cache before startup and prefetches checkpoints, because on GB300 the cached files otherwise use the GPU memory the KV cache needs. Context-boundary, stop and resume, reinstall and throughput checks remain pending.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash is a mixture-of-experts language model with 284 billion parameters, 13 billion active per token, and support for up to 1 million tokens of context. This recipe serves it with FP4 expert weights across two DGX Spark nodes joined by a 200 Gbps link, or across two DGX Station nodes, with an 8,192-token context.

qualification.reason: Previous qualification used a recipe-level thinking override and explicit output-token budgets. Verification with model-default thinking and server-default output and sampling settings is deferred until after merge. Earlier validation is retained below and does not qualify these defaults.

previousAutomaticHelmValidation.reason: The original Flash checkpoint passed packaged Helm TP2 serving and retained-cache lifecycle checks on two GB300s. NCCL used TCP sockets on the verified 400 Gbps interfaces. Link speed is not a measured throughput result.

observedWorkload.tokenCounter: Pinned SGLang DeepSeek V4 encoder and checkpoint tokenizer, checked against server usage

otherModelIsolation.reason: TP2 uses both available GPUs. Shared CPU services were verified while the model was stopped.

artifactEvidence.memoryEstimate: 148.66 GiB stored checkpoint per host. Retained-cache reinstall measured rank 0: host cgroup peak 153.25 GiB, device use 77.86 GiB; rank 1: host cgroup peak 152.23 GiB, device use 78.02 GiB. Hardware memory floors and 128/320 GiB host request/limit remain enforced.
artifactEvidence.scope: Artifact and hardware evidence is retained. Previous Station inference qualification used an explicit thinking override. The Station retest with model-default thinking and server-default output and sampling settings is deferred until after merge; these defaults remain unqualified.

startupFindings.failure: The first start rejected complete cached safetensors because huggingface_hub 1.33.0 uses cache-wide Xet blobs.
startupFindings.fix: Validate the repository ETag SHA256 through the two-link shared-blob layout while enforcing cache path confinement. Hardware and memory guards remain enabled.

startupFindings.failure: SGLang TP memory-balance guard rejected 179.34 GiB versus 222.77 GiB free memory. Linux file pages for this checkpoint occupied GPU NUMA memory.
startupFindings.fix: Use POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED only on validated checkpoint safetensors before runtime memory sizing. No global page-cache eviction, file deletion or disabled memory guard.
startupFindings.observedAfterCleanup: Both ranks passed the unchanged memory-balance check and began loading with 247.41 GiB available.

startupFindings.failure: The non-mmap safetensors 0.8.0 loader raised KeyError F8_E8M0 on checkpoint scale tensors.
startupFindings.fix: Use the runtime standard mmap loader, verified against a real checkpoint scale tensor, with sequential shard iteration.

startupFindings.failure: After reading all shards, model loading waited on asynchronous expert weight copies. A pod-scoped stack sample showed the worker threads in expert_data.copy_. Prefetch alone still left 31 worker threads waiting on the CUDA driver write lock in cuMemcpyHtoDAsync.
startupFindings.fix: Use checkpoint prefetch plus a checksum-pinned loader workaround that clones CPU tensor inputs before entering CUDA copies. Preserve GPU parameter tensors, weight contents, hardware checks and memory guards.

runtimeSourcePatch.scope: Materialize CPU weight tensors before asynchronous GPU copies. Applied only to the exact pinned loader source in each model container, without modifying checkpoint data or disabling guards.
